A '''pulse-lightspeed holo-image transmitter''' was a communication device that allowed [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] messages to be transmitted between [[Starship/Legends|starships]] traveling in [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. It had a range of three [[Star system/Legends|star systems]].
